lines.speaker: MARIA
lines.text: They're here! Rizzo's men are breaking through the front door[cite: 38, 39]!

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: Hold them off! I'm five minutes out[cite: 39]!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Gunfire echoes through the house as Jackie kicks the door in to secure the family[cite: 39, 40].
